# kind: # Roles: W write target | RW read-then-write target | DEL delete operand (member/subscript path write; identifier no write)
#  DECL:<k> binding declaration (k: declarator var/let/const by parent, param, catch, fn-hoist, fn-inner, class, class-inner, import, enum, namespace)
#  FORHEAD for-in/of left: DECL:declarator when `kind` is present, else W | INHERIT pattern internals (role of the pattern root)
#  WRAP lvalue-transparent wrapper (R in read context, inherits W/RW/DEL in target context) | R evaluated read
#  RDEF read evaluated later (instance field initializer) | N non-variable or no runtime binding | T type position
#  IMPORTNAME import_specifier.name: DECL:import without alias, else N
# Order (evaluation relative to the enclosing write construct or statement): text = source order |
#  before-target = evaluated before the construct's targets are written (assignment/declarator value,
#  for-in/of iterable) | after-body = for-statement update clause, runs after the body and starts each
#  later visit of the header | deferred = runs at a later, unknown time (callable bodies and parameters,
#  instance field initializers; a `static` field initializer is eager and is treated as text at runtime)
